280488466.description:
Hemingray Glass Insulators - 3 Piece Lot
Hemingray No. 12, CD 113
Aqua Blue-Green, Vintage Mid-Century
This lot features three vintage glass telegraph/telephone insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, once the world's largest manufacturer of glass insulators. The No. 12 model was a standard utility piece used extensively across North American communication lines. Today, these pieces are highly sought after by collectors for their historical significance, industrial aesthetic, and the iconic aqua color characteristic of Hemingray production.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray No. 12, Aqua, Drip Point Base - Visible base chip
Glass Insulator, Hemingray No. 12, Aqua, Drip Point Base - Minor base roughness
Glass Insulator, Hemingray No. 12, Aqua, Drip Point Base - Small skirt chips
Condition:
These pieces show varying degrees of wear consistent with salvaged utility glass. One insulator has a significant chip/chunk missing from the bottom skirt edge as shown in photos. The remaining two pieces show smaller fleabites, surface scratches, and general rim roughness along the base edges. The molded "HEMINGRAY No 12" marks remain legible on all pieces, and the glass retains its original color and clarity with typical manufacturing bubbles and mold lines.
